extracted.name: Fried Cooking Squash (Cucumbita sp.)
extracted.description: Great recipe for Fried Cooking Squash (Cucumbita sp.).
ingredient_lines: Generous amount of sunflower seed oil for frying
instruction_lines: The cucumbita sp. Is maybe a lesser known type of the squash family. It has a white peel, and in my country its quite popular for cooking thick soups, hence the name cooking squash
Peel and slice the squash into thin slices, gently salt it, cover the slices with flour, then egg, lastly bread crumbs and fry them in hot oil.
